description: The org-wide issues inbox (GET /issues): every task issue across projects, newest first, filtered by status (OPEN, ACKNOWLEDGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, or a comma list), project_id and site_id. Pass issue_id instead to read one issue's message thread (GET /issues/:id/messages). For one list use tascan_list_issues. Read tier.

issue_id.description: Read this issue's thread instead of the inbox

name: tascan_issues_inbox
